title: Concept: Overly open CORS (apache) — review required
description: In apache, Header set Access-Control-Allow-Origin * accepts origins beyond the application's own, so other sites can read responses that carry the user's session. The remedy is an explicit list of trusted origins (an expression-mapped origin), without credentials for wildcards.
applicability: apache API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
